about.body: The AJ200 is Jaguar Land Rover's 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine, part of the Ingenium family. It entered production in 2016, a year after the diesel AJ200D, and is one of the key engines in Jaguar's modern four-cylinder lineup. Within Jaguar, it appears in two very different applications - the E-Pace compact SUV and the F-Type sports car. The engine is available in three power outputs (200 hp, 250 hp, and 300 hp) depending on the application. Beyond Jaguar, the same Ingenium engine family is also used by Land Rover, though our work here covers Jaguar-badged applications specifically.

byModel.body: The AJ200 is fitted across two Jaguar models. In the E-Pace (X540, 2017-present), it powers the P200, P250, and P300 variants - the petrol options across the compact SUV range. In the F-Type (X152, 2016-2020), the AJ200 was offered as the 2.0i variant during the model's later years, before the F-Type range consolidated around V8 options.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ200 spans two quite different applications - one a compact SUV, the other a sports car - compatibility depends on confirming your exact model and year, which we do by registration. Ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ between E-Pace and F-Type applications, and the F-Type-specific tuning components are not shared with the SUV application. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
